title: 第44章 追踪第43章 跑路
lines: 苍茫十万大山连绵万里，古木参天遮天蔽日，凶兽咆哮此起彼伏，幽深峡谷纵横交错，是大荒之中最凶险也最易隐匿踪迹的绝地。
白枫周身乌光破空，一路横穿密林险峰，经脉依旧残留着圣灵一击带来的钝痛，体内灵力消耗飞速加剧。
唯有识海之中闵天幡缓缓流转温润功德金光，一丝丝纯净的功德之力绵绵不绝涌入四肢百骸，抚平肉身伤势，补齐耗损灵力，让他亡命奔逃的速度始终维持在巅峰，不曾衰减半分。
可身后那道猩红如火的流光，依旧阴魂不散。
火山身为圣灵境强者，掌控空间之力，赶路速度本就远超圣尊之下所有修士，即便隔着千山万壑，依旧死死锁定白枫身上残存的鸦火气息，二者之间的距离，还在肉眼可见地不断拉近。
轰隆——后方虚空不断炸裂，滚烫鸦火从天而降，砸落山林，成片千年古木瞬间燃成灰烬，灼热气浪席卷四方，逼得白枫只能不断变向逃窜，前路越来越窄。
白枫眸光冷冽，面色沉凝，心底无比清楚。
正面抗衡，他绝非圣灵强者一合之敌；长久奔逃，自身灵力终究有耗尽的一刻，闵天幡的功德终究会有被耗尽的一刻，而到时候自己的灵气恢复速度也跟不上持续追杀的消耗。
再这样漫无目的地狂奔，被追上只是时间问题。
身后，火山的怒喝穿透层层山林，裹挟冰冷杀意直逼白枫耳畔：
“卑微人族蝼蚁，你逃不掉的！
乖乖停下，交出闵天幡与一身秘宝，我可以给你一个痛快！”
火山眼底杀意翻腾，心底的忌惮也越来越浓。
他越发心惊这名神游境修士的逆天底蕴：肉身硬抗圣灵一击而不死，有先天灵宝护身，自愈能力骇人，奔逃速度更是比肩普通圣尊。
越追杀，他越想要夺走白枫身上所有至宝，也越发坚定斩杀白枫的决心。
一个神游境便能威胁到圣灵强者颜面的怪物，绝不能留在世间。
心念既定，火山不再保留自身力量，周身血色鸦火尽数爆发，虚空被焚烧出一道道漆黑裂痕，追杀速度再度暴涨，转瞬之间，已然追到白枫百丈之内，大手覆满烈焰，直接隔空朝着白枫后背抓来！
百丈之内，圣灵威压彻底锁死空间，白枫身形骤然一顿，四面八方空间凝固，根本无法再继续瞬移逃窜。
死局，近在眼前。
白枫眼神没有丝毫慌乱，极致危机之下，他反而彻底冷静下来。
他目光快速扫过四周地形，此刻自己恰好身处一处万丈地底裂谷之中，裂谷深处地脉之气狂暴紊乱，空间本身就极不稳定，恰好可以遮掩一切神魂与气息探查。
机会，就在此刻！
白枫没有转头迎战，也没有继续徒劳奔逃，心念一动，直接催动体内蛰伏的小世界残片。
嗡——温润柔和的空间道韵瞬间笼罩白枫全身，没有丝毫外放光芒，极致内敛。
白枫同时收敛全身所有气息、灵力、神魂波动，连闵天幡的圣光与功德之力也尽数收入体内，不露半点异象，整个人如同一块毫无生机的顽石。
紧接着，他借着裂谷紊乱地脉的掩护，依靠小世界残片逆天的空间隐匿能力，直接原地彻底隐匿，肉身融入周遭空间缝隙之中，彻底断绝自身所有气息轨迹。
content_en:
The vast mountains stretch for thousands of miles, towering ancient trees block out the sky, ferocious beasts roar one after another, and deep canyons crisscross each other. It is the most dangerous and easily hidden place in the wilderness.
Black light pierced the sky all over Bai Feng's body, and he traversed the dense forest and dangerous peaks all the way. The dull pain caused by the Holy Spirit's blow still remained in his meridians, and the consumption of spiritual power in his body increased rapidly.
Only the warm golden light of merit flowed slowly from Min Tianban in the sea of ​​consciousness, and traces of pure power of merit poured into his limbs and bones continuously, healing his physical injuries and replenishing his lost spiritual power, allowing his escape speed to remain at its peak without slowing down.
But the scarlet fire-like light behind him still lingered.
As a strong man in the Holy Spirit Realm, Huo Huo controls the power of space, and his speed is far faster than all the monks under the Holy Lord. Even though they are separated by thousands of mountains and valleys, they are still locked on the remaining crow fire aura on Bai Feng's body. The distance between the two is still getting closer visibly to the naked eye.
Boom - the void behind continued to explode, and scalding crow fire fell from the sky, smashing down the mountain forest. Thousands of ancient trees instantly burned to ashes, and waves of scorching hot air swept across all directions, forcing Bai Feng to constantly change directions and flee, and the road ahead became increasingly narrow.
Bai Feng's eyes were cold, his face was solemn, and his heart was extremely clear.
In a head-on confrontation, he is by no means an enemy of the powerful Holy Spirit; after running for a long time, his spiritual energy will eventually be exhausted, Min Tianfan's merits will eventually be exhausted, and by then his spiritual energy recovery speed will not be able to keep up with the consumption of the continuous pursuit.
If he keeps running aimlessly like this, it will only be a matter of time before he is overtaken.
Behind him, the roar of the volcano penetrated the layers of the mountain forest, carrying the cold murderous intent and reaching Bai Feng's ears:
"You humble human ant, you can't escape!
Stop obediently and hand over the Min Tianban and a secret treasure, and I can give you a pleasure! "
The murderous intent surged in Huoshan's eyes, and the fear in his heart became stronger and stronger.
He became more and more frightened by the heaven-defying heritage of this Fugue Realm monk: his physical body could withstand a Holy Spirit's blow without dying, he was protected by innate spiritual treasures, his self-healing ability was terrifying, and his running speed was even comparable to that of ordinary saints.
The more he chases, the more he wants to take away all the treasures from Bai Feng, and the more determined he is to kill Bai Feng.
A monster that can threaten the face of a Holy Spirit powerhouse at the Fugue Realm must not remain in the world.
With his mind set, the volcano no longer retained its own power, and all the bloody crow fire erupted all over the body. The void was burned with black cracks. The pursuit speed increased again. In an instant, it had caught up to within a hundred feet of Bai Feng. His big hands were covered with flames, and he grabbed Bai Feng directly from the air!
Within a hundred feet, the pressure of the Holy Spirit completely locked the space. Bai Feng's figure suddenly stopped, and the space in all directions solidified, making him unable to teleport and escape.
Death is at hand.
There was no trace of panic in Bai Feng's eyes. In the extreme crisis, he calmed down completely.
His eyes quickly scanned the surrounding terrain. At this moment, he happened to be in an underground rift valley. The energy of the earth veins deep in the rift valley was violent and chaotic, and the space itself was extremely unstable, which could cover all soul and breath exploration.
The opportunity is now!
Bai Feng did not turn around to fight, nor did he continue to run away in vain. With a thought, he directly activated the dormant fragments of the small world in his body.
Buzz - The gentle and gentle spatial Dao rhyme instantly enveloped Bai Feng's whole body, without any outward rays of light, and was extremely restrained.
At the same time, Bai Feng restrained all the aura, spiritual power, and soul fluctuations in his body, and even the power of Min Tianban's holy light and merits were absorbed into his body, without revealing any vision, and the whole person was like a lifeless stone.
Immediately afterwards, he took advantage of the cover of the chaotic earth veins of the rift valley and relied on the incredible space hiding ability of the fragments of the small world to completely hide in place. His body blended into the gaps in the surrounding space, completely cutting off all traces of his own aura.
